text:
Olivia Park: Quick follow-up from the PM: pattern seems repeatable = brief host OOMs -> stream cut -> clients immediately re-open -> reconnect storm -> many sessions show 1 partial chunk then close. We need short-term mitigations + owners and a timeline.

Diego Ramos: I can take the LB affinity and healthcheck side. Hypothesis: affinity TTL < client streaming TTL causing flips during host recycle. I'll produce a config diff and a small canary plan by EOD.

Lena Fischer: I'll own runtime mitigations: server-side reconnect throttle + faster shard GC on model unload. Plan: open a draft PR with feature flag, unit tests, and a staging rollout in 24h.

Maya Roy: I'll do the customer impact tally and draft comms. CS saw ~5 customers with degraded streams in the last 3 incidents. Will hold comms until we have a concrete mitigation timeline.

ops-bot: Incident snapshot: 2024-09-15T03:20Z - partial_response_peak=3.5%, reconnect_median=2, median_reconnect_interval=380ms, affected_regions=[us-east-1].

Olivia Park: Action list (owner / deliverable / ETA):
- LB affinity diff + canary -> Diego (config + 5% canary 36h)
- Runtime throttle feature flag -> Lena (PR + tests 24h, staged rollout 48h)
- Observability slices + alert rule -> Olivia (dashboard tile & alert in 12h)
- Customer one-pager draft -> Maya (48h after mitigation plan)

Diego Ramos: Quick proposed LB change:
```
session_affinity_ttl: 90s -> 240s
healthcheck_grace: 8s -> 30s
treat_302_as_unhealthy: true
```
I'll stage in pool-b at 5% and monitor.

Lena Fischer: Runtime draft config in PR:
```
streaming:
  reconnect_throttle_ms: 600
  max_reconnects_per_session: 5
  reconnect_jitter_ms: 250
  shard_gc_aggressiveness: high
```
Feature behind flag: reconnect_throttle_v2. Adding handshake jitter tests.

Olivia Park: Observability ask: per-session reconnect histogram, partial_chunk_index distribution, and host oom count per minute. Alert idea: partial_rate > 2% && reconnect_rate > 1% for 1m -> page + tag @oncall.

Diego Ramos: Update 2210556001: found two edge pools with affinity TTL mismatch; uploaded diff to /infra/lb/affinity-2210556001.diff. Starting 5% canary at 10:00 UTC.

Lena Fischer: Update 2210556300: PR opened -> https://git.internal/r/redwood/runtime/pulls/4365 (draft). Unit tests passing locally, integration tests running. Staging rollout scheduled after tests.

Olivia Park: Update 2210556580: dashboard tile up; early canary metrics show partials down ~22% and reconnects down ~35% in canary pool. Good signal. We'll keep the canary running and reconvene tomorrow. If anyone hits blockers post here. :thumbsup:
